m: Glaze: whisk the miso, mirin, honey and soy until smooth.
Cook the rice, then stir through the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt and sugar while it's hot.
Heat the grill to high. Lay the salmon skin side down on a lined tray, pat dry, and spread the glaze thickly over the tops.
Grill 7 to 9 minutes, without turning, until the glaze is blistered and dark in spots and the salmon just flakes. Watch it closely at the end: miso catches fast.
Meanwhile steam the broccoli and beans 4 minutes, then toss with the sesame oil, a pinch of salt and sesame seeds.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the greens, spring onion and a wedge of lime.
l: Flake the salmon over rice and greens. Best eaten cold or barely warm.
g: Use a GF miso (many contain barley, so check) and tamari instead of soy, glazing the GF fillets separately.
